Container.Name: airtrail
Container.Overview:
AirTrail is a self-hosted flight tracker. Log your flights, see them on a world map, and explore statistics and the countries you have visited.
Needs a PostgreSQL database: install the airtrail-db template first, or point DB_URL at a server you already run. Setup guide: https://airtrail.johan.ohly.dk/docs/install/unraid
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL database, such as the airtrail-db template.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the AirTrail web interface is published on.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Airline icons and other uploaded files.

Config.Name: ORIGIN
Config.Description: The exact URL you open AirTrail at, such as http://192.168.1.10:3000 or https://airtrail.example.com. Sign-in fails when it does not match the browser's address bar.

Config.Name: DB_URL
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection URL. With the airtrail-db template, replace change-me with its POSTGRES_PASSWORD.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container runs as. Uploads are given to this user on every start. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the container runs as. 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: UPLOAD_LOCATION
Config.Description: Container path for uploads. Must match the Uploads path above.
